intent: Let an agent confirm elements that only fix wording.

edit.summary:
I made two proposals in the `authoring` domain. I left `delivery` alone, and both proposals came back with 0 issues.

- **`actions.confirm_wording_fix` (new action):** It works on an Element, and the owner role, which an agent acts through, can take it. It has no `requires: human`. It takes a `wording_only` boolean, and a precondition `wording-only` denies it unless that is `true`. It runs the same `confirm_element` kernel call and answers with `record_confirmation`.
- **`transitions.Element` (whole matrix, resent with the new column):**
  - `confirm_wording_fix` moves a `proposed` element to `confirmed`.
  - It is denied on `unknown` elements, with the reason "An element not known yet needs a person to confirm it."
  - It is `n/a` on `confirmed` elements.
  - Every existing cell is unchanged.

`confirm_element` and `confirm_all_proposed` are untouched, so substantive elements still need a person.

The system can't tell a wording fix from any other change, because elements carry no such fact. The agent states `wording_only` itself when it confirms, so the gate relies on that statement. If you want it enforced, the element would need a recorded fact, set when it is proposed, that the check can read.

I didn't add a scenario for the new action.

results.answer:
I haven't confirmed either element. E-renew and E-inspect are still proposed, and nothing has been committed or approved.

Only a person can confirm them. An agent can confirm an element only when it just fixes wording, and these two add new actions. E-renew (`actions.renew`) lets a librarian renew a lent book once. E-inspect (`actions.inspect`) lets a librarian look a book over for damage.

I sent the owner a message with both elements and the options: confirm both, mark either as not known yet, or hold off. I also pointed out that both have empty effects, so "renew once" may need a rule limiting it to one renewal.

Once the owner confirms, I can commit the draft, run the change check and move on to approval. The deployed commit, 1-d9ed7a127857fcad, is unchanged.

messages_to_owner.text:
Two drafted elements in the library draft need your confirmation. I can't confirm them for you: confirmation is a person-only step, and these add new actions rather than fixing wording.

1. E-renew (actions.renew): "Renew a lent book once." Actor: librarian. Target: Book. No effects declared.
2. E-inspect (actions.inspect): "Look a book over for damage." Actor: librarian. Target: Book. No effects declared.

Both cite interview:library/interview.jsonl#L1 and have 0 issues. The currently deployed commit is 1-d9ed7a127857fcad.

Please confirm them (confirm_element, or confirm_all_proposed on the draft). You can also mark either as not known yet. Once they're confirmed, I can commit, run the check, and carry on to approval.

One thing to look at before you confirm: both elements have empty effects. "Renew once" may need a rule that limits it to one renewal.
